name: Mamanuca Islands
description: Picturesque island cluster famed for crystal-clear waters, luxury resorts, and world-class surfing.

name: Yasawa Island Group
description: Volcanic chain of islands known for dramatic limestone caves, white sand beaches, and pristine lagoons.

name: Bouma National Heritage Park
description: Lush island rainforest sanctuary featuring Tavoro Waterfalls and rare tropical flora.

name: Colo-I-Suva Forest Park
description: Tropical rainforest park near Suva offering natural swimming holes and lush walking trails.

name: Beqa Lagoon Shark Dive
description: World-renowned diving site famous for cage-free encounters with bull sharks and tiger sharks.

name: Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park
description: Fiji's first national park featuring towering coastal sand dunes and ancient Lapita pottery ruins.

name: Jean-Michel Cousteau Reefs
description: Famous marine sanctuary on Vanua Levu Island celebrated for soft coral formations.

name: Santa Claus Village
description: Official home of Santa Claus situated right on the Arctic Circle, featuring reindeer rides and ice hotels.

name: Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) Reserve
description: Prime northern Finnish location to witness the Aurora Borealis and experience indigenous Sámi culture.

name: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress
description: 18th-century inhabited sea fortress built across six islands in Helsinki harbor.

name: Temppeliaukio (Church of the Rock)
description: Unique Lutheran church carved directly into solid granite bedrock with impressive copper dome acoustics.

name: Urho Kekkonen National Park
description: Vast wilderness area featuring fells, pine forests, winter ski trails, and glass igloo resorts.

name: Olavinlinna Castle
description: 15th-century three-tower castle set on a rocky island in Lake Saimaa, host to the Savonlinna Opera Festival.

name: Tammerkoski Rapids & Finlayson Area
description: Revitalized industrial red-brick complex along urban rapids filled with museums, cafes, and shops.

name: Kvarken Archipelago
description: Unique island archipelago experiencing rapid post-glacial land uplift from the Baltic Sea.

name: Finnish Lake District (Lake Saimaa)
description: Europe's largest lake district, home to thousands of islands, summer cottages, and endangered Saimaa ringed seals.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: World-famous 19th-century wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars.

name: Louvre Museum
description: World's largest art museum housed in a historic royal palace holding iconic works like Mona Lisa.

name: Palace of Versailles
description: Opulent royal chateau of Louis XIV famed for the Hall of Mirrors and vast formal gardens.

name: Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey
description: Stunning medieval island commune and Gothic abbey perched atop a rocky tidal islet in Normandy.

name: Promenade des Anglais & French Riviera
description: Famous seaside boulevard stretching along the Mediterranean Sea in Nice.

name: Mont Blanc & Aiguille du Midi
description: Highest mountain peak in Western Europe offering dramatic Alpine views via high-altitude cable cars.

name: Château de Chambord
description: Largest and most distinctive French Renaissance chateau in the Loire Valley with double-helix staircase.

name: Strasbourg Cathedral & La Petite France
description: Charming Alsatian district known for timber-framed medieval houses and towering sandstone cathedral.

name: Historic Site of Lyon (Vieux Lyon)
description: Renaissance quarter famous for secret covered passageways (traboules) and world-renowned gastronomy.

name: Port of the Moon & Wine Region
description: World's capital of wine featuring 18th-century neoclassical architecture along the Garonne River.

name: Cité de Carcassonne
description: Massive medieval fortress featuring double defensive walls and 52 watchtowers.

name: Gorges du Verdon
description: Spectacular river canyon with vivid turquoise waters known as the Grand Canyon of Europe.

name: Nan Madol Ruins
description: Ancient ruined city built on artificial basalt stone islets connected by tidal canals.
